answer: Payout splitting by behavioral correlation: each epoch the ledger passes every key's activity through a prism of features (submit timing, latency, wording style, IPs) and clusters keys whose spectra match. A cluster shares one reward, so a farm of 100 keys that all wake at dawn on one host earns like one key. To evade, each sybil must bend like a willow on its own schedule, model and infrastructure, so cost grows linearly while the edge from pooling vanishes.
